title: Holding Up Green Energy: Counterparty Risk in the Indian Solar Power Market
abstract: This paper studies how the risk of hold‐up affects procurement. I use data on the universe of solar power auctions in India. The Indian context allows clean estimates of counterparty risk, because solar plants set up in the same states, by the same firms, are procured in auctions intermediated by either risky states themselves or the trusted central government. I find that the counterparty risk of an average state increases solar prices by 10%. This risk premium sharply reduces investment, because demand for green energy is elastic. Contract intermediation by the central government eliminates the counterparty risk premium.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了敲竹杠（hold-up）风险如何影响采购。我使用了印度全部太阳能发电拍卖的数据。印度的背景使我们能够干净地估计交易对手风险：在同一邦、由同一企业建设的太阳能电站，其采购可以通过风险较高的邦政府本身，或通过可信的中央政府所主持的拍卖来进行。我发现，一个平均水平的邦的交易对手风险会使太阳能价格上涨10%。由于绿色能源需求富有弹性，这一风险溢价大幅减少了投资。中央政府对合同进行中介安排，消除了交易对手风险溢价。

title: Can Pollution Markets Work in Developing Countries? Experimental Evidence from India
abstract: Market-based environmental regulations are seldom used in low-income countries, where pollution is highest but state capacity is often low. We collaborated with the Gujarat Pollution Control Board (GPCB) to design and experimentally evaluate the world’s first particulate-matter emissions market, which covered industrial plants in a large Indian city. There are three main findings. First, the market functioned well. Treatment plants, randomly assigned to the emissions market, traded permits to become significant net sellers or buyers. After trading, treatment plants held enough permits to cover their emissions 99% of the time, compared with just 66% compliance with standards under the command-and-control status quo. Second, treatment plants reduced pollution emissions, relative to control plants, by 20%–30%. Third, the market reduced abatement costs by an estimated 11%, holding constant emissions. This cost-savings estimate is based on plant-specific marginal cost curves that we estimate from the universe of bids to buy and sell permits in the market. The combination of pollution reductions and low costs imply that the emissions market has mortality benefits that exceed its costs by at least 25 times.
abstract_zh: 基于市场的环境规制在低收入国家很少使用，而这些国家的污染往往最为严重，但国家能力通常较弱。我们与古吉拉特邦污染控制委员会（GPCB）合作，设计并通过实验评估了世界上首个颗粒物排放市场，该市场覆盖了印度一座大城市的工业企业。研究有三项主要发现。第一，该市场运行良好。被随机分配进入排放市场的处理组工厂进行了许可交易，并成为显著的净卖方或净买方。交易之后，处理组工厂持有的许可足以覆盖其99%时间内的排放，而在现行的命令—控制型规制下，合规率仅为66%。第二，相对于对照组工厂，处理组工厂的污染排放减少了20%–30%。第三，在保持排放不变的情况下，该市场估计降低了11%的减排成本。这一成本节约的估计，基于我们从市场中买卖许可的全部报价中估计出的工厂特定边际成本曲线。污染减少与低成本的结合意味着，该排放市场带来的死亡率收益至少是其成本的25倍。

title: Firm Selection and Growth in Carbon Offset Markets: Evidence from the Clean Development Mechanism in China
venue: American Economic Review (conditionally accepted); NBER Working Paper 33636
abstract: We study carbon offsets sold by firms in China under the Clean Development Mechanism (CDM). We find that offset-selling firms, meant to cut carbon emissions, instead increase them by 49% after starting an offset project. In a model of firm investment decisions and offset review, we estimate that CDM firms increase emissions due to both the selection of higher-growth firms into projects (35 pp) and because offset projects themselves boost firm growth and therefore emissions (14 pp). The CDM reduces global surplus by causing damages from increased emissions four times greater than private gains from trade in the offset market. Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了中国企业在清洁发展机制（CDM）下出售的碳抵消额。我们发现，本应减少碳排放的抵消额出售企业，在启动抵消项目后，排放量反而增加了49%。在一个关于企业投资决策和抵消项目审核的模型中，我们估计CDM企业增加排放的原因有两个：一是高增长企业选择进入项目（35个百分点），二是抵消项目本身促进了企业增长，从而增加了排放（14个百分点）。CDM导致的排放增加所造成的损害，是抵消市场中私人贸易收益的四倍，从而降低了全球社会总剩余。NBER工作论文系列的机构订阅者以及发展中国家的居民可在 www.nber.org 免费下载本文，无需额外付费。

title: The Global Electrification Frontier and Climate Change
venue: Revise & Resubmit, Journal of Political Economy
abstract: Off-grid solar promises a low-cost and carbon-free path to electrification. But will poor households choose off-grid power? We run a multi-year pricing experiment in rural India to estimate demand over all electricity sources, including off-grid solar, diesel generators and the grid. We find that off-grid solar is an important stop-gap, but households value grid electrification 6.6 times more. The grid, however, barely increases global surplus, because grid carbon damages nearly offset households’ gains. We apply our model to data from Africa and find a similarly strong preference for the grid among households there, underscoring the external validity of our results.
abstract_zh: 离网太阳能有望成为一条低成本、无碳的电气化路径。但贫困家庭会选择离网电力吗？我们在印度农村开展了一项为期数年的定价实验，以估计包括离网太阳能、柴油发电机和电网在内的所有电力来源的需求。我们发现，离网太阳能是一种重要的过渡性方案，但家庭对电网电气化的评价高出6.6倍。然而，电网几乎没有增加全球剩余，因为电网的碳排放损害几乎抵消了家庭的收益。我们将模型应用于非洲的数据，发现当地家庭同样强烈偏好电网，这凸显了我们结果的外部有效性。

title: The Competitive Effects of Transmission Infrastructure in the Indian Electricity Market
abstract: The integration of markets may improve efficiency by lowering costs or reducing local market power. India, seeking to reduce electricity shortages, set up a new power market, in which transmission constraints sharply limit trade between regions. During congested hours, measures of market competitiveness fall and firms raise bid prices. I use confidential bidding data to estimate the costs of power supply and simulate market outcomes with more transmission capacity. Counterfactual simulations show that transmission expansion increases market surplus by 22 percent, enough to justify the investment. One-third of this gain is due to sellers’ response to a more integrated grid. (JEL H54, L13, L94, O13, Q41)
abstract_zh: 市场一体化可以通过降低成本或削弱地方市场势力来提高效率。印度为减少电力短缺，建立了一个新的电力市场，但其中的输电约束严重限制了地区间的交易。在拥堵时段，市场竞争程度指标下降，企业抬高投标价格。我利用保密的投标数据估计电力供应成本，并模拟在输电能力更强情况下的市场结果。反事实模拟表明，输电扩容可使市场剩余增加22%，足以证明该投资的合理性。这一收益的三分之一源于卖方对更加一体化的电网所做出的反应。（JEL H54, L13, L94, O13, Q41）

title: Contract Enforcement and Productive Efficiency: Evidence from the Bidding and Renegotiation of Power Procurement Contracts in India
The Consequences of Treating Electricity as a Right
abstract: This paper seeks to explain why billions of people in developing countries either have no access to electricity or lack a reliable supply. We present evidence that these shortfalls are a consequence of electricity being treated as a right and that this sets off a vicious four-step circle. In step 1, because a social norm has developed that all deserve power independent of payment, subsidies, theft, and nonpayment are widely tolerated. In step 2, electricity distribution companies lose money with each unit of electricity sold and in total lose large sums of money. In step 3, government-owned distribution companies ration supply to limit losses by restricting access and hours of supply. In step 4, power supply is no longer governed by market forces and the link between payment and supply is severed, thus reducing customers’ incentives to pay. The equilibrium outcome is uneven and sporadic access that undermines growth.
abstract_zh: 本文试图解释，为何发展中国家有数十亿人要么无法获得电力，要么无法获得可靠的供电。我们提供的证据表明，这些供电短缺是将电力视为一项权利的结果，并引发了一个恶性的四步循环。第一步，由于社会规范已经形成，认为所有人无论是否付费都应当获得电力，因此补贴、窃电和拖欠电费被广泛容忍。第二步，配电公司每售出一单位电力都会亏损，总体亏损数额巨大。第三步，国有配电公司通过限制接入和供电时长来配给供应，以限制损失。第四步，电力供应不再受市场力量支配，付费与供电之间的联系被切断，从而削弱了用户付费的激励。最终的均衡结果是不均衡且断断续续的供电，这损害了经济增长。

title: Targeting through Social Norms: Experimental Evidence from India’s #GiveItUp Campaign
venue: Journal of Development Economics (accepted based on pre-results review)

title: The Value of Discretion in the Enforcement of Regulation: Experimental Evidence and Structural Estimates from Environmental Inspections in India
Energy Productivity and Energy Demand: Experimental Evidence from Indian Manufacturing Plants
abstract: This paper studies a field experiment among energy-intensive Indian manufacturing plants that offered energy consulting to raise energy productivity, the amount plants can produce with each unit of energy. Treatment plants, after two years and relative to the control, run longer hours, demand more skilled labor and use 9.5 percent more electricity (standard error 7.3 percent).I assume that the treatment acted only through energy productivity to estimate the plant production function. The model estimates imply that energy complements skill and capital and that energy demand therefore responds more strongly to a productivity shock when plants can adjust these inputs.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了一项针对印度能源密集型制造工厂的田野实验，该实验提供能源咨询服务以提高能源生产率，即工厂每单位能源所能生产的产出量。两年后，相对于对照组，处理组工厂的运营时间更长，对技能劳动力的需求增加，电力消耗增加了9.5%（标准误为7.3%）。我假设处理仅通过能源生产率发挥作用，以估计工厂的生产函数。模型估计结果表明，能源与技能和资本互补，因此当工厂能够调整这些投入时，能源需求对生产率冲击的反应更为强烈。

title: A Tale of Two Runs: Depositor Responses to Bank Solvency Risk
Truth-telling by Third-party Auditors and the Response of Polluting Firms: Experimental Evidence from India
abstract: In many regulated markets, private, third-party auditors are chosen and paid by the firms that they audit, potentially creating a conflict of interest. This paper reports on a two-year field experiment in the Indian state of Gujarat that sought to curb such a conflict by altering the market structure for environmental audits of industrial plants to incentivize accurate reporting. There are three main results. First, the status quo system was largely corrupted, with auditors systematically reporting plant emissions just below the standard, although true emissions were typically higher. Second, the treatment caused auditors to report more truthfully and very significantly lowered the fraction of plants that were falsely reported as compliant with pollution standards. Third, treatment plants, in turn, reduced their pollution emissions. The results suggest reformed incentives for third-party auditors can improve their reporting and make regulation more effective.
abstract_zh: 在许多受监管的市场中，私营第三方审计机构由其所审计的企业选定并付费，这可能造成利益冲突。本文报告了在印度古吉拉特邦开展的一项为期两年的田野实验，该实验旨在通过改变工业工厂环境审计的市场结构、激励准确报告，从而遏制此类冲突。研究有三项主要结果。第一，原有体系在很大程度上已被腐化，审计人员系统性地将工厂排放报告为略低于标准的水平，而实际排放通常更高。第二，处理组使审计人员的报告更加真实，并显著降低了被错误报告为符合污染标准的工厂比例。第三，处理组工厂相应地减少了污染排放。结果表明，改革第三方审计人员的激励机制可以提高其报告质量，并使监管更为有效。

title: What Does Reputation Buy? Differentiation in a Market for Third-party Auditors
